desc:
You bought an old restaurant, cash, sight unseen. Nobody has eaten here in twenty years. The tables are still set, the grill is still in the kitchen, and nobody ever cleaned up. Simple enough. Just one room at a time.

Except nobody has been down to the basement in a very long time...

Clean the whole restaurant, front door to back alley, and bring it back to life!

How to play:
🗑️ Pick up trash, mop spills and scrub away the grease
🧽 Buy upgrades to clean faster and carry more
🚪 Finish a room to unlock the next part of the restaurant
👥 Clean solo or with friends. Solo progress saves!
✨ Clean 100% of the restaurant to see the ENDING and unlock Hard Mode!

Tags: restaurant, clean your restaurant, cleaning, cleaner, janitor, kitchen, mop, story, relaxing, simulator
